description: List the user's PENDING approval requests: asks from connected apps (create a card, view full card details, close/pause/resume a card, change a limit) waiting on the user's decision. Surface each one to the user and let THEM decide; after the user answers, resolve with approve_request. NEVER approve or deny on your own — an approval is the user's consent, not yours. Personal sessions only; company-connected sessions have no personal inbox.
name: list_pending_approvals

approvals.description: Pending, unexpired approval requests, newest first. Each is waiting on the user's decision.

actionLabel.description: Human verb for the ask, e.g. 'Create a card'.

appName.description: The app or company asking, when known.

card.description: The card the ask is about (null for card-creation asks).

connectedCard.description: For cards created against the user's added card: the real card behind it (issuer, brand, last4, nickname).

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the ask was made.

expiresAt.description: ISO timestamp when the ask expires unanswered.

id.description: Approval id. Pass as approval_id to approve_request once the user decides.

params.description: Structured numbers bound to the ask, e.g. { amountCents } or { newLimitCents }.

summary.description: Short human summary of the ask, e.g. "$25.00 card".

message.description: Human-readable list of pending approvals (or an empty-state note).

status.description: Present only when the list is unavailable: "personal_surface_only" for company-connected sessions.
